_about: Single source of truth for subagent/workflow/invoke model selection (2026-09-29, Sonnet 5.5 remap). Sonnet 5.5 EXECUTES (default; env CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL=sonnet sets only the DEFAULT); Opus 5.5 JUDGES — review, UI/UX, plan, spec, debug (agent_pins + invoke_categories); escalation lifts execution agents to Opus on a failed previous attempt or large unplanned work; Fable is explicit opt-in only. Guard precedence: session flag > per-project mode (state/model-modes) > explicit model param or [label] > agent pin > escalation > default, where a request for a pinned agent, an escalation executor, or fable counts only when the user's own last prompt carries an override_phrases entry for that model (opus-guard, audit 2026-10-05 E-04); otherwise it is ignored and the reason is logged. model_ids are the Agent-tool ALIASES (the valid-model set), not API ids. Evidence: ~/reports/Sonnet 5 5 release feedback.md.

agent_pins._comment: subagent_type -> forced model. Opus = judgment roles (Opus 5.5 leads on review, factual accuracy, ambiguous work). Execution agents are NOT pinned: they default to sonnet and go through `escalation`. Fable is never auto-pinned.

task_matrix._comment: TaskProfile intent -> model, read only by the router's main-session model_advice (/invoke per-act models come from invoke_categories; opus-guard has no TaskProfile and skips this). Anything unlisted -> default (sonnet). Fable never appears here.

heavy_qualifiers._comment: HEAVY_ARCHITECTURE / DEEP_DEBUG main-session advice and the opus-guard `escalation` size rule fire only when size:L AND risk>=2 in the TaskProfile — a keyword alone never promotes.

invoke_categories._comment: Judgment acts run on opus (they match the opus agent_pins); IMPLEMENT and every other act inherit the Sonnet default, and the guard's escalation still applies to /invoke impl dispatches (no model= is passed).

escalation._comment: opus-guard step after agent_pins: lifts an execution agent to `to` when (1) a retry_marker matches (a previous attempt failed), or (2) no plan_marker matches AND prompt_router.classify gives size >= heavy_qualifiers.min_size AND risk >= heavy_qualifiers.min_risk. A referenced plan/spec/contract means the work is well-scoped: Opus planned, Sonnet executes. An explicit model param or a session/project mode wins over escalation. Regexes are case-insensitive; any error -> no escalation (fail-open).

effort_defaults._comment: Documentation of the effort tiers (agent `effort:` frontmatter is the source; test_model_policy_consistency checks it). Frontmatter is the ONLY lever: Claude Code (checked through 2.1.285) reads no subagent-effort env var — CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT is not in the binary — so built-ins (general-purpose, Explore, Plan) run at Claude Code's own default. Executors stay at high because Sonnet 5.5 at xhigh is very verbose (~2.5x the cost of high for ~10% more score). `max` burns tokens and times out, so it is banned.
effort_defaults.closers: medium (deadcode-reaper, docs-sync-agent, qa-verifier); santa-reviewer xhigh and security-sentinel high

override_phrases._comment: Explicit user phrases that force a model for that turn. opus-guard reads them from the user's last real prompt (lib/model_mode.user_phrase): only then may an explicit model / [label] move a pinned agent, an escalation executor, or select fable. model_advice reads them to stay silent.

session_flags._comment: Flag files under ~/.claude/<dir>/; presence forces that model on every subagent/workflow agent. Precedence sonnet > opus > fable (sonnet is the kill-switch).

main_session_advice._comment: Heavy-task line, addressed to the main model (the user never types a model switch): when the TaskProfile hits an opus row of task_matrix AND heavy_qualifiers pass, the line says to dispatch the Opus judge agent in `agents` (opus-guard pins it) for the heavy part. Otherwise silent. Consumed by prompt_router/modules/model_advice.py.
